jobs.title: Affiliate & Partnerships Manager
jobs.exp: Experience in affiliate marketing, performance partnerships or lead generation. No year count.
jobs.why: Runs a network of affiliates, publishers and lead partners and sets commission terms. Closest match to your CryptoNewsZ affiliate work (40% ROI lift, 30% network growth).

jobs.title: Product Growth & Partnerships Manager
jobs.exp: No year count in the posting.
jobs.why: Partnerships plus growth in one role, with a stated salary well above your floor.

jobs.title: Partnership Specialist
jobs.exp: 2 to 3 years in partnerships and affiliate marketing, including affiliate network work (onboarding, tracking, reporting).
jobs.visa: Not mentioned. UK work authorisation needed.
jobs.why: Reads like your CV: affiliate networks, partner onboarding, reporting. Fashion marketplace, which is one of your target sectors.

jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Manager, Product Partnerships
jobs.exp: 4+ years of partnerships, including product, integration or platform partnerships, at a startup or scale up.
jobs.why: Matches your 4 years exactly. Product and integration partnerships is a step away from affiliate work, so lead with the onboarding and partner growth results.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager
jobs.exp: Proven experience in strategic partnerships or business development. No year count. Title is senior.
jobs.why: Large European tech employer with a real partnerships function. The senior title is the risk, so apply with a short, specific note on the results you drove. Needs a free CV Keskus login to apply.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, B2C
jobs.exp: No year count. Commercial, numbers first.
jobs.visa: UK based role. Check right to work before applying.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Affiliate Marketing
jobs.exp: 1+ year of account management. Junior to your level.
jobs.visa: Not mentioned. UK work authorisation needed.
jobs.why: Affiliate network inside the industry you work in. Lower seniority than your four years, but a safe way into a large affiliate employer.

jobs.title: Growth Manager
jobs.why: Remote and open worldwide.

jobs.title: Affiliate Manager
jobs.exp: Proven affiliate management, ideally iGaming, fintech, SaaS or B2B telecom. No year count.
jobs.why: Recruits and manages traffic affiliates on CPA and revenue share terms for a business phone provider. Direct use of your affiliate onboarding experience.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (SaaS, remote, EU)
jobs.exp: Values affiliate network and coupon platform experience. No year count.
jobs.visa: EU based. Check what residence they need.
jobs.pay: EUR 40,000 to 60,000, adjusted to your EU country
jobs.why: Remote from Zagreb works. B2C growth with affiliate and platform channels, and a clear salary band.

jobs.title: Growth & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
jobs.exp: Proven retention, lifetime value and revenue growth work. No year count.
jobs.pay: EUR 1,600 to 2,000 a month, the page says both gross and net
jobs.why: Email and SMS journeys plus Google and Meta ads for clients. Pay is lower, but it is remote and fresh. Needs a free CV Keskus login to apply.

jobs.title: Partnerships and Activation Manager

jobs.lang: English. You may apply in English.
jobs.why: Partnership strategy across athletes, influencers, OEM partners and events. You apply by email, so it fits how you already work.
jobs.emailNote: Subject: Partnerships Manager. Say where you saw the job.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead (Multi Market)
jobs.exp: About 2 years in growth, social or content marketing.
jobs.why: Growth across video, social, email and partnerships with AI content workflows. Content heavy, so a weaker fit than the affiliate roles. Needs a free CV Keskus login to apply.

jobs.title: Organic Growth Lead
jobs.exp: Strong SEO and organic growth results, lead level, fintech or marketplace background preferred.
jobs.why: Good pay and an SEO lead role. Uses your +150% traffic result, but it is a lead position, so treat it as a stretch.
